articles.title: Fortnite's Nikki Skin Sparks Debate Among Horror Fans, With Some Calling for a Boycott
articles.summary: A vocal group of Fortnite players are calling for a boycott of Epic's battle royale game after a skin of Obsession’s Nikki Freeman, played by Inde Navarrette, sparked backlash among fans.
body: On October 20, Epic Games revealed that Nikki Freeman is coming to Fortnite in a special collaborative video with the character’s actress, Inde Navarrette. And while there’s no denying Obsession’s popularity — Nikki was one of the most-searched Halloween costumes on Google this year, after all — her inclusion as a purchasable skin in a video game is rubbing some fans the wrong way.

This uncomfortable reaction is in direct response to Nikki being the victim of Bear’s wish in Obsession. In the movie, Nikki’s body is overtaken by a malicious entity while the real Nikki is locked away in her own mind, unable to do anything but watch as the entity possessing her commits atrocities while wearing her skin.

Needless to say, making Nikki — who is a victim of rape — a playable character in a video game isn’t exactly being met with positivity from some folks in Fortnite’s playerbase. That’s not including her special emote, which sees her hold up Wiley E. Coyote-style signs reenacting the famous dinner scene where she flips out on Bear, or the skin’s recreation of her iconic frown.

articles.title: Christopher Nolan’s The Prestige 20th Anniversary Re-Release Includes 70mm and IMAX
articles.summary: To celebrate the film’s 20th anniversary, Disney will re-release Christopher Nolan’s The Prestige in theaters on January 29, 2027. The thriller will be released on 70mm and IMAX for the first time, and will also be presented in 35mm and Digital 2D formats.
body: “I’m very excited to bring ‘The Prestige’ back to the big screen, and particularly thrilled to offer audiences the chance to see it on 70mm film, and on IMAX for the first time,” Nolan said in a statement.
The studio’s announcement was made 20 years to the day that The Prestige was released (October 20, 2006).
Check out the new poster for The Prestige's 20th anniversary re-release below.

The Prestige stars Hugh Jackman, Christian Bale, Michael Caine, and Scarlett Johansson in a suspense tale about rival illusionists obsessed with becoming the greatest magician of all time, no matter what it costs them.

articles.title: Here Are The Mechanics and Dozens Of New Cards From Magic: The Gathering’s Star Trek Set
articles.summary: After a year that featured alternate realities, ninja turtles, superheroes, and hobbits, the final Magic: The Gathering expansion of 2026 is going where no Universes Beyond set has gone before, as Star Trek is scheduled to launch in November.
body: Today, Wizards of the Coast revealed the mechanics players can expect in the set, along with dozens of new cards from both the main set and the preconstructed Commander decks. We also got a glimpse at some of the set's special treatments, including the seven cards that will come signed by the people depicted on the artwork.
Seven new mechanics--two of them found only in the Commander cards--highlight the set, along with a eighth mechanic returning from 2024's Edge of Eternities.

First is Beam Me Up, which allows you to cast certain spells from your graveyard by returning a creature you control to its owner's hand and paying a separate cost. The example card provided is Open Communications, which normally costs a single blue mana, but you can cast it again from your graveyard by returning a creature to its owner's hand and paying two generic and one blue mana.

articles.title: Shrek 2 Remastered Reveal Trailer Parodies GTA 6, Sets November Release Date
articles.summary: Shrek 2 Remastered is real, and its release date is less than a month away. As revealed during today's ID@Xbox showcase for October 2026, Aspyr Media has recreated a cult classic tie-in game from the original Xbox era for 2026.
body: The reveal trailer offers a sneak peek at how fan-favorite playable characters and classic moments from DreamWorks' fairytale sequel have been upgraded with improved graphics, new features, and more. It's been a while since players were able to play as Shrek, Fiona, Donkey, Gingy, and more, but you can get a taste of some of what's in store in the footage below.

You may have noticed that the opening isn't something from the original Shrek 2. Aspyr took today's announcement trailer as an opportunity to acknowledge the elephant in the room: That its November release date puts it within spitting distance of Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto 6. Set for release just nine days later, November 19, GTA 6 seems to have convinced most other games to steer clear of its launch window – but not Shrek.

Instead of shooting for a different date, Shrek 2 Remastered is sticking to its November 10 plan. The trailer takes a tongue-in-cheek jab at Rockstar's latest, going as far as to not only recreate its Vice City vibe but even come up with its own version of that iconic Grand Theft Auto box art, too.

articles.title: Arctic Eggs, Mouthwashing, and No, I'm Not a Human Are Coming to Xbox | IDXBOX
articles.summary: Three indie games that achieved viral status over the last three years are making their long-awaited debut on Xbox from publisher Critical Reflex. As revealed during today's ID@Xbox showcase for October 2026, celebrated indie titles Arctic Eggs, Mouthwashing, and No, I'm Not a Human are making…
body: Physics-focused game Arctic Eggs tasks players with cooking eggs in — you guessed it — the Arctic. It sounds easy enough, but the game’s physics make this chore a true test of patience. And it’s not just eggs you’ll have to cook, either; you’ll pan fry anything from cockroaches to shot glasses, sausages, stingrays, and more, with the aim of feeding the city’s hungry inhabitants and possibly earning an audience with the Saint of Six Stomachs. Arctic Eggs, from developer The Water Museum, is available today (October 20, 2026) on Xbox Series X/S.

No, I’m Not a Human is an unsettling tale that follows a homeowner in an increasingly uninhabitable world. Players must decide who to shelter and who to turn away as the days grow hotter, with mysterious beings crawling out of the ground — beings that look, and sometimes behave, like humans. Pick the real people and wait out the apocalypse together; pick impostors and risk your housemates’ lives. No, I'm Not a Human will be available on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Xbox Game Pass in 2027.

articles.title: Xbox Series X|S Is Getting A Surprise Graphics Boost From AMD
articles.summary: Sony isn't the only company introducing new upscaling technology to its flagship PlayStation 5, as Microsoft and AMD have announced that FSR 4.1 is coming to more devices--including Xbox Series X|S consoles--in the future.
body: Similar to Sony's hardware-accelerated upscaling solutions for PS5 and PS5 Pro, AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) 4.1 is an advanced, machine-learning-based temporal image upscaling and reconstruction technology that can render a game at a lower resolution and then upscale it to a higher resolution.

While it's highly doubtful that Xbox Series X|S consoles will start offering PS5 Pro-like graphics (both consoles lack dedicated hardware for machine-learning algorithms), this should still give owners a noticeable bump in graphical quality and performance if implemented properly.

articles.title: Sony Boss: “Creativity Is For Humans, Not AI”
articles.summary: Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick and Sony Group President and CEO, Hiroki Totoki, commented on the future of gaming today at the Paley International Summit. Naturally, the topic of AI came up, and Totoki believes AI technologies will not replace humans in game development, in part because of the…
body: "Creativity is for humans, not AI,” Totoki said, as reported by IGN. “How to use the technology profile is important. Of course, I encourage my people to use AI in a certain manner, but at [the] same time we try to keep the rights and rights holders and creators and artists.”
For his part, Zelnick said it's his belief that AI itself will not replace a developer, but instead, people who don't embrace AI might be replaced by people who do.

"I’m fond of saying AI is a collection of datasets, compute, and large language models. That’s what it is. And datasets, by definition, are backward-looking. That’s all they are. And creativity, at its best, is forward-looking," he said.

Zelnick said ideas that are "completely unexpected" don't come from algorithms--they come from creative people making surprising, original choices. To make his point, Zelnick said when he was an executive at Fox, he oversaw the release of Home Alone, a movie that no one expected to be a success.

articles.title: Fallout 4: FEVer Dreams Gets Official Surprise Release
articles.summary: Bethesda just gave everyone a solid reason to boot up Fallout 4 again — even if you've already racked up hundreds of hours in the post-apocalyptic RPG and its many expansions. A new release brings back Courtenay Taylor and Brian T. Delaney, the original actors who voiced Fallout 4 's protagonists.
body: You begin the adventure trapped, without any weapons and seemingly poisoned by an active strain of the Forced Evolutionary Virus. Though there are shooting elements, FEVer Dreams switches things up by offering players an escape room-style dungeon full of puzzles. It's a lore-heavy experience that promises to shed light on Fallout's notorious bioweapon. Expect some familiar faces — but with some totally new gear and weapons.

The new campaign is the work of modding group @kinggathcreates, but unlike most fan creations, FEVer Dreams was made in partnership with Bethesda. In fact, the game's description reads, "Presented by Bethesda Game Studios."

articles.title: 10 Years After The Switch 1 Reveal, I Still Haven’t Played A Game At A Rooftop Party
articles.summary: It's now been a full decade since Nintendo announced the first Switch, which is almost hard to believe, given how fresh that reveal trailer still feels in our heads. Heaps of hype and a lack of information from Nintendo about its Wii U successor, codenamed "NX," led to the company's fanbase…
body: Reports and rumors pointed to the NX as a console-handheld hybrid, but Nintendo didn't fully unveil the Switch until October 20, 2016 (an announcement preluded by a photo of Mario being a creep ). The three-and-a-half-minute video made it clear how Nintendo wanted players to interact with the Switch, showing several scenarios where people take their games on the go.

Rewatching that trailer today, it's amusing to look back at how Nintendo foresaw the social impact of the Switch. Some moments from the trailer manifested in reality, while others were hilariously exaggerated.

You have a guy taking his dog (and his copy of The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild) out on a walk, a traveler playing Skyrim on a plane and putting the game on his television upon his arrival home, and professional Splatoon players practicing before their big moment on stage.

articles.title: A New DC Green Lantern Has Officially Been Unveiled
articles.summary: HBO's Lanterns may have just ended with no second season in sight yet, but Green Lantern fans still have a promising new interpretation of the classic DC hero to look forward to. DC Comics announced Green Lantern: Doomed Cosmos on Tuesday, a miniseries with a unique take on the Green Lantern corps.
body: From writer Dan Watters and artist Kyle Hotz, Green Lantern: Doomed Cosmos is an Elseworlds story where the Green Lanterns look a helluva lot like Space Marines from Warhammer 40,000. They're big dudes wielding big weapons while fighting a big ol' cosmic war.

In Doomed Cosmos, the Empire of Humanity is conquering the stars, and only the beefed-up Green Lanterns are left to stop them. Hal Jordan is the only human fighting against the Empire after being betrayed by Oliver Queen, whom you know in main DC Comics continuity as Green Arrow. I guess in this universe, Jordan and Queen never bonded during a road trip across America together in the 1970s.

"Visually, I am trying to walk the line between over-the-top space opera and the emotional beats of the story," Hotz said in a news release. "I want to get the feeling across that the Lanterns are beat up, tired, and certainly the underdogs. Their armor is cracked and broken, and their weapons are held together with tape and wire. These are soldiers nearing the end of their fight."
points: HBO's Lanterns may have just ended with no second season in sight yet, but Green Lantern fans still have a promising new interpretation of the classic DC hero to look forward to.

articles.title: New Cheaper PS5 Officially Available for Pre-Order Now
articles.summary: With the cost of a PlayStation 5 going up and up in price since the console's launch in 2020, late adopters are looking at a $599 entry-level price if they want to play Grand Theft Auto 6 on PS5 this November.
body: The bad news? It's only available in Japan. But if you're willing to jump through some (serious) hoops, the new cheaper PlayStation 5 is now available for pre-order.

Sony announced the new PlayStation 5 Digital Edition Midnight Black earlier this month, with pre-orders going live on Oct. 20. The system will be released on Nov. 19 (the same day as GTA 6 ) and costs 55,000 yen, which translates to about $350 in the U.S. As the name suggests, the new edition wraps the entire console and the included DualSense controller in a sleek, matte-black finish. It's also digital-only, meaning no built-in disc drive support, but since there's no physical edition of GTA 6 on the horizon, that shouldn't matter much to price-conscious buyers.
That said, Sony is selling a disc drive add-on for PlayStation fans who want to use disc-based games. The Midnight Black disc drive for PS5 sells for 11,980 yen (about $75).

articles.title: Ex-Call of Duty designer "who survived the crunch" in order to launch Black Ops 1 & 2 calls out executives "raking it in" from sales of remasters
articles.summary: A former long-time Call of Duty developer has called out Activision executives profiteering from the re-release of games like Black Ops 1 and 2, whereas the developers who contributed "blood, sweat, and tears" to make them gained nothing.
body: Gavin Goslin worked at Treyarch for more than 15 years as a level artist and level designer, and in a LinkedIn post reacting to low effort re-releases of Black Ops 1 & 2 this year, said: "They are printing money off of work completed over a decade ago.

"As a developer who actually worked on both BO1 and BO2, seeing these charts is bittersweet. I poured my life into those games, spending countless, brutal hours in crunch alongside an incredibly talented team to make sure they were perfect. Seeing our blood, sweat, and tears still dominating the charts in 2026 is amazing, but it's hard to watch the suits rake in giant financial windfalls from our old code while the actual creators don't see a dime of it."

The post was subsequently picked up by various gaming websites - a recirculation Goslin reacted to in a separate post on LinkedIn today. "I am glad this critical conversation is gaining traction," Goslin said.

articles.title: Marvel Rivals Officially Brings Avengers: Endgame's Final Fight to Life
articles.summary: Thanos has his work cut out for him. NetEase just revealed the first gameplay footage of Marvel Rivals ’ new “Path to Doomsday - Avengers: Endgame ” PvE mode, and it features a whopping 50 players taking on the Mad Titan at once.
body: While this 50-player PvE mode seems out of step with Marvel Rivals’ usual six-versus-six multiplayer matches, NetEase Games has been building toward this moment. The game previously added a PvE zombie mode where four players face off against a horde of undead that seems to behave like Thanos’ army of underlings. Rivals also already supports a chaotic 18-versus-18 player mode, as well as the Times Square Hub, where up to 100 players can gather. Still, combining the game’s larger-scale multiplayer with PvE will create a new kind of chaos. The mode will be released with Rivals ’ upcoming Season 10.5 update on Oct. 23.

Marvel Rivals’ upcoming update unfortunately breaks one of the game’s most impressive streaks: for the first time in 17 months, it won't get two new heroes in a season. While Rivals has added a new character roughly every month for over a year (seasons generally last two months, with a big update at the middle point of a season), NetEase announced that Season 10 will have only one new character, Gorr the God Butcher, so the team can focus on the many new modes coming to the game.

articles.title: Founder of bankrupt Samson studio mulls how to use AI for his next attempt: 'Cutting corners in game development has a habit of coming back to bite you in the ass'
articles.summary: Christopher Sundberg said the goal for his next studio is to make "a game we can afford to finish without needing every sales forecast to come true."
body: Christofer Sundberg, the founder of Samson developer Liquid Swords, has confirmed the studio's closure, saying that while the console version of the game enjoyed "much greater success" than the PC release, it "wasn't enough to get the company across the finish line."

Reports over the weekend revealed that Liquid Swords had gone bankrupt just six months after the PC release of Samson, which was followed by a console launch in September. "It's been a hell of a ride and a lot of fun, even when the circumstances gave us very little to laugh about," Sundberg wrote. "Building a studio, creating Samson and releasing it on PC and consoles took an enormous amount of work from people who cared deeply about what we were making.

"The console versions met with much greater success than the PC release. We got them out, but that success wasn't enough to get the company across the finish line. Market conditions and some bad business decisions brought us here, and I own my part in that. I can look honestly at what went wrong and still be proud of what we built."
points: Christopher Sundberg said the goal for his next studio is to make "a game we can afford to finish without needing every sales forecast to come true."

articles.title: Helldivers 2 studio warns mods may break as it switches to new anti-cheat, and the negative reviews are dropping on Steam like Hellbombs
articles.summary: Heads up, Helldivers: Arrowhead Game Studios is moving Helldivers 2 from GameGuard to Easy Anti-Cheat today, and that means some mods—including those that don't have any impact on gameplay—may stop working.
body: Helldivers 2 doesn't have official modding support, but there are plenty of them out there —most either cosmetic or audio replacements. Arrowhead said in a Steam update that while it hasn't previously taken a position on mods beyond warning that it can't guarantee their safety or usability, it's seen a recent uptick in cheat mods and it can't let that stand.

"We know mods are part of the DNA of PC gaming and gaming communities as a whole," the studio wrote. "In general, we appreciate the creativity behind cosmetic and non-gameplay mods, which players can enjoy without negatively impacting those who play alongside them.
"Where we need to improve is how we protect players against modifications that create unfair advantages or negatively impact others, which goes beyond software manipulation to tamper with our game."

Meanwhile, DF Supporter have questions about GTA 6 on PlayStation and in the absence of actual information, we can only offer our thoughts and speculation.
